title: Existence (Krylov–Bogolyubov): Hölder-in-space estimate misapplied with psi=0 (missing h(V) term)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Where:** the "Existence of an invariant measure" paragraph (Krylov–Bogolyubov), eq. `eq:spatial-incr`, term $(\mathrm{II})$ in `solution.tex`.

**The claim.** Existence is obtained by a uniform-in-time spatial Hölder bound. For $u_0=0$, $0\le t\le1$, the drift contribution to the spatial increment is
$$(\mathrm{II})=\Big\|\int_0^t\!\!\int_D\big(p_{t-r}(x,y)-p_{t-r}(z,y)\big)\,h^{(m)}(u_r(y))\,dy\,dr\Big\|_{L_m},$$
and the solution bounds it by "applying `c:39`–`c:310` (the Hölder-in-space estimate `holder`/`holderex`) with $\phi=u-V$, $\psi=0$", concluding $(\mathrm{II})\le C|x-z|^{\mu}$.

**Gap (genuine error).** `holderex`/`mainresdif`/`c:310` are **difference** estimates: with $\phi=u-V,\ \psi=0$ they control the spatial increment of
$$\int_0^t\!\!\int_D(p_{t-r}(x,y)-p_{t-r}(z,y))\big(h^{(m)}(u_r(y))-h^{(m)}(V_r(y))\big)\,dy\,dr,$$
since $b(V+\phi)-b(V+\psi)=h(u)-h(V)$ (and the bound even carries the prefactor $\|\psi-\phi\|^{2/3}=\|u-V\|^{2/3}$). This is **not** $(\mathrm{II})$: it differs by the pure-noise drift term
$$(\mathrm{III})=\Big\|\int_0^t\!\!\int_D(p_{t-r}(x,y)-p_{t-r}(z,y))\,h^{(m)}(V_r(y))\,dy\,dr\Big\|_{L_m},$$
which is nowhere addressed and is itself a (nontrivial) regularisation-by-noise estimate for the spatial regularity of the singular drift along the stochastic convolution. There is **no single-$\phi$ Hölder-in-space estimate** in `L26` — only `mainres` (a time-increment, single-$\phi$ bound with no spatial increment). Hence the bound $(\mathrm{II})\le C|x-z|^\mu$ that feeds Kolmogorov continuity and the Krylov–Bogolyubov tightness is **not established**.

**Distinct from prob-05-10.** That issue concerns the Feller property and the restart decomposition over $[n,n+1]$. The present gap is an *incorrect application of a difference estimate to a single-drift quantity on the first interval $[0,t]$* and persists even granting everything in prob-05-10.

**To fix.** State and prove a single-$\phi$ Hölder-in-space SSL estimate, e.g.
$$\Big\|\int_S^T\!\!\int_D(p_{T_0-r}(x,y)-p_{T_0-r}(z,y))w_r\,b(V_r+\phi_r)\,dy\,dr\Big\|_{L_m}\le \Gamma|x-z|^\mu(T-S)^{\frac34-\frac\mu2}\big(1+[\phi]_{\mathcal X}(T-S)^{1/2}\big),$$
using the SSL spatial-increment germ together with the **signed-kernel** part of `c:key` (already available for $\rho=-1$, $\mu\in(0,1]$, giving the factor $|x-z|^\mu(T_0-r)^{-\mu/2}$ and germ exponent $\tfrac34-\tfrac\mu2>\tfrac12$ for $\mu<\tfrac12$). Apply it with $\phi=u-V$ to bound $(\mathrm{II})$ directly; the spurious $\psi=0$ substitution into a difference estimate must be removed.
